_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with Micron's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Micron Technology, Inc., including its consolidated subsidiaries, is an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions.' 'We have experienced volatility in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory and storage products which may adversely affect our business.' 'The semiconductor memory and storage markets are highly competitive.' (FY2018 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names the cloud and crypto-mining only among the markets Micron sells into ('The cloud server market was CNBU's fastest growing market in 2018, particularly in datacenters, with significant increases in DRAM content per server.'; 'for the graphics and crypto-mining markets'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no other theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker, so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'Micron Technology, Inc., including its consolidated subsidiaries, is an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions.' 'We have experienced volatility in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory and storage products which may adversely affect our business.' 'The semiconductor memory and storage markets are highly competitive.' (FY2018 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names the cloud and crypto-mining only among the markets Micron sells into ('The cloud server market was CNBU's fastest growing market in 2018, particularly in datacenters, with significant increases in DRAM content per server.'; 'for the graphics and crypto-mining markets'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no other theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker, so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.21x; +170% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.42; conservative 2yr -26%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -52.1%/yr (worst year FY10-FY19 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -40.3%/yr (Q1 FY20 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16 median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.9%/yr (FY10-FY19 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +33.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 ex-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MU (retrospective, 2019-10-04) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.21x (89.0% downside to Bear $4.91 / +40.2% upside to Bull $62.48) | Adj composite 1.39 vs market 2.81: gap -1.42 [OVERVALUED] | +170% above the EPP floor $16.53 (3x FY20E $5.51) | Conservative 2-yr case: -25.8% total (-12.9%/yr) | At 8.1x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $58.92 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue -42.3% YoY in Q4 FY19, forward revenues -39.3% to -34.3% (Q1 FY20 revenue guide (Q4 FY19 results (8-K ex.99.1, Business Outlook))); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
